simple.summary: רֶסֶן (Reçen) means Resen , a place in Assyrian First listed occurrence: Gen 10 12.

definitions.full: H7449. Resen II. רֶ֫סֶן proper name, of a location in Assyria, near Nineveh Gen 10:12 ; Δασεμ (probably = rêš êni, head of spring ; compare Dl Pa 261 COT 10:12 ).
